en:
Hashiba Hideyoshi invaded Bitchu
and, as Takakage had foreseen,
besieged Takamatsu Castle. First he
offered Muneharu the whole of
Bitchu Province if he would defect,
but was flatly rebuffed, and at once
switched to Kuroda Kanbei's plan.
He dammed the Ashimori River, built a long levee and flooded the castle town. Cut off by water,
the castle was awash even within its walls.
Riverbank Formed by the Flood Siege

note: Mitsuhide drops any honorific here; plain 'Nobunaga' kept.

'Bitchu-Takamatsu Castle: Living Quarters' is 40 characters (limit 36); short form 'Takamatsu Castle' used, as 'Koriyama Castle' for Yoshida-Koriyama (U00728). 33 characters. Alt: 'Bitchu-Takamatsu: Living Quarters' (33).
